## Quick Start

You've selected the **Cloudburst Agent**. The core skills are already loaded—no need to load them separately.

**For any task:**
1. Describe what you want to build (component, fix, feature).
2. The agent will follow the [core-agent-workflow](/skills/cloudburst-agent/references/core-agent-workflow.md): intake → plan → build in slices → test → document.
3. If new patterns emerge, they'll be captured in the skill references so the next task is even faster.

**Example prompts:**
- "Build a new button variant called 'ghost-secondary' that matches the design-tokens and Vuetify theme."
- "Implement the avatar component from [Figma link] into packages/avatar."
- "Fix the footer spacing on the web app—it's using the wrong token."
